PLAT-102 is live: `billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint` with the same value, in the shared config and in every app that used it. I ran `st done`.

**PR:** mono #1, merged. CI passed, and CD on `main` succeeded.

**What changed:** four lines in four files:
- `libs/shared-contracts/index.js`
- `apps/core-shell/src/config.js`
- `apps/sub-route-billing/src/main.js`
- `apps/sub-route-reports/src/main.js`

No `billingUrl` reference remains in the shared config or any of the three apps. All three apps built locally before I opened the PR. I did not check that they start up once deployed, beyond CD reporting success.

**Assumptions:**
- **No platformkit change:** the shared config lives in `libs/shared-contracts` in the monorepo, and the platformkit repo has no reference to `billingUrl`, so I left it alone.
- **No alias:** I did not keep `billingUrl` as a compatibility alias, since the ticket asks for no remaining references.
- **Single PR:** the shared library is inlined into the apps at build time, so one PR covered everything.

**Surprises:** nothing slowed me down. The docs say CD only builds `core-shell` and `sub-route-billing`, so the reports app may not have been redeployed by this change.
